text_zh: 北京城市轨道可用受理标识对应的境外银行卡拍卡过闸，也可在自助机拍卡买单程票；具体卡种看现场标识。
text_en: Accepted overseas bank cards can be tapped at Beijing rail gates or used at ticket machines. Check the displayed card-network logos.

text_zh: 成都公交和地铁提供支付宝、云闪付绑定境外卡后扫码乘车的方式；开通时按应用指引选择当地交通服务。
text_en: For Chengdu buses and metro, Alipay and the UnionPay app (云闪付) offer travel QR codes linked to overseas bank cards. Follow the app instructions for the local transport service.

text_zh: 上海地铁服务中心提供小额兑币及境内外银行卡购票服务；不能正常进出站时找站员处理。柜台刷卡购票与拍卡过闸是不同流程。
text_en: Shanghai Metro service centers provide small-change exchange and ticket purchase with domestic or overseas bank cards. Ask staff about gate problems. Counter ticket purchases and bank-card gate entry are separate processes.

text_zh: 在重庆轨道交通车站售票亭，可询问实体计期票的现金或受理银行卡POS购票方式；本条不含璧铜线，票种和价格向站员确认。
text_en: At Chongqing Rail Transit ticket booths, ask about cash or accepted bank-card POS payment for physical period passes. This guidance excludes the Bitong Line (璧铜线); confirm pass types and prices with staff.

text_zh: 深圳地铁客服中心可用POS机受理的境外银行卡购票；先核对卡种，不把柜台刷卡购票等同于直接刷卡过闸。
text_en: At Shenzhen Metro customer service centers, supported overseas bank cards can buy tickets through POS terminals. Check accepted card logos; buying a ticket is separate from tapping a card at a gate.

text_zh: 八达岭长城的“长城内外”小程序支持护照信息订票，现场也有护照购检票渠道；出发前复核预约要求，不套用到其他景点。
text_en: For Badaling Great Wall (八达岭长城), the Changcheng Neiwai (长城内外) mini program supports passport bookings, and on-site passport ticketing/checks are available. Recheck requirements before visiting; other attractions have separate rules.

text_zh: 重庆中国三峡博物馆的预约系统提供护照证件选项；按馆方当日预约说明办理，不将其套用到重庆所有场馆。
text_en: The Chongqing China Three Gorges Museum (重庆中国三峡博物馆) reservation system accepts passports. Follow the museum’s current booking instructions; this does not establish the rules for other Chongqing venues.
